w: During the evening assembly Swamishri said, "One should selflessly serve and offer devotion to God and desire only to please God. If however, one nourishes other motives while offering devotion then one's devotion is only hypocritical. Devotion should be offered with a pure feeling, to please God only...."
Swamishri visits Jalaram Mandir for darshan.
The evening assembly today was celebrated as a symbolice Jholi Utsav. Over 20,000 devotees attended.

A symbolic Joli-Uttarayan festival was held in the presence of Swamishri. After a traditional dance by balaks and kishores a drama ' Samarpan' was performed by kishores and yuvaks. Then Swamishri blessed the Satsang assembly.

After Viveksagar Swami’s discourse on the Shrimad Bhagvad Gita, the Youth Day programme commenced on the theme of ‘Message’. Youths dressed as great characters, ancient and modern (like Lakshman, Arjun, Bharatji, Dada Khachar, etc.), voiced their life messages of self-control, austerity, renunciation, etc. This was followed by a traditional dance on the bhajan “Nav Yuvano Shrijino Sandesh85” Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.
After the satsang assembly, when Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to his residence, youths were standing there waiting for him. As soon as they saw Swamishri, they all burst out with the lines,
"As you make us dance, so we will dance,
pour out your colour..."

"What does 'make us dance' mean?" Swamishri asked the youths. Answering himself, he said, "If we obey God's commands and do not dance as the mind makes us dance, then we can be said to have danced by God. We should live according to God's commands. That is how to dance. There should be no addictions or vices, bhajan should be done as well as possible, studies should go as well as possible, the best possible degree should be obtained, parents are to be served, devotion is to be offered. When we do all this, we can be said to have danced for God. Otherwise, boys and girls dancing about is all useless. With God, we are to dance the way Mira, Narsinh and the sadhus did, by obeying His commands."
Those eager youths now learnt to dance in the true sense.

ds.t: This is how to dance for God
w: After the satsang assembly, when Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to his residence, youths were standing there waiting for him. As soon as they saw Swamishri, they all burst out with the lines:
"As you make us dance, so shall we dance,
Pour your colour over us..."

"What does 'make us dance' mean?" Swamishri asked the youths. Answering himself, he said, "If we obey God's commands and do not dance as the mind makes us dance, then we can be said to have danced by God. We should live according to God's commands. That is how we have to dance. No addictions or vices should remain, bhajan should be done as well as possible, study should be done as well as possible, the best possible degree should be obtained, we have to serve our parents, we have to offer devotion. If we do all this, it can be called dancing for God. Otherwise, boys and girls dancing wildly is all useless. With God we have to dance the way Mira, Narsinh and the sadhus obeyed His commands."
Those exuberant youths now learned to dance in the true sense.

Doing all this is called dancing for God. Otherwise, boys and girls dancing around is all useless. With God, we are to dance the way Mira, Narsinh and the saints obeyed His commands."
Those eager youths now learnt to dance in the true sense.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti for the murtis of BAPS hari mandirs in Dali (Mahelav region), Amod (Mahelav region) and Godavadi (Sankari region).
